minor.issue: Deep tier Opus call can take 60-120s and is occasionally 502'd by upstream provider OR by the K8s ingress (preview env returns 502 'environment is not responding' when latency > ~60s). Verified working via internal localhost:8001 — not a backend bug, but external clients may need retry logic. Main agent already verified via curl in iter54.

issues: Bar widths now correctly proportional to max (top surface bar fills ~full track, others scaled to it). The numeric label still reads 'X% OF WINDOW' computed as pct-of-total — bar geometry uses max-in-window per spec but label phrasing could read as % of top surface. Cosmetic; metric is unambiguous given the absolute call count next to it.

critical_code_review_comments: decks.py — clean separation of concerns: outline (standard tier) → generate (deep tier with quota) → quality_check (fast tier) → feedback. The 409 guard on outline.consumed_deck_id correctly forces users to iterate the outline rather than burn another deep slot on the same brief. _safe_json fallback (regex extraction) is a sensible last-ditch for occasional Sonnet/Opus formatting drift.

decks.generate — when budget is exhausted, llm_tier_quota downgrades served_tier to 'standard' (Sonnet) and returns quota.downgraded=true, but the deck record still stores tier from llm_out.tier (which is 'standard' in that case) and model_id is sonnet. UI should make this visible — currently in admin telemetry the 'tier_served' field in deck_telemetry captures it correctly. Consider surfacing a banner in the deck UI when downgraded=true.
admin_llm_spend.deck_quality — uses isoformat cutoff string against created_at field which is also iso8601 — sound for string comparison since iso strings are lexicographically ordered.

inbound_email — UUID fallback resource_id correctly applied at both bad_attachment (line 276) and virus_scan (line 286) paths. message_id or f'no-id-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}' guarantees uniqueness. Verified via live EICAR webhook — returned ok:false error:virus_scan, audit log row written.
